## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed (if any). Include relevant motivation and context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / MCP tool (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Static type check: `pnpm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] Automated tests: `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Project build: `pnpm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Tested with live MCP client (e.g. Claude Desktop, Antigravity, Cursor)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and conventions of this project
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md` and `README.pt-BR.md`) where appropriate
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
